title: Alone
description: What if you were all alone in Minecraft
body:
**What if you were all alone in Minecraft?**

This mod adds a new dimension where you'll spawn in once you join the world,

there will be no animals, no villagers, no one. just, you.

 
This mod adds :

- Beta/unused textures for all new blocks
- One single dimension
- New ore with new tools, weapons and armors (the corruptionite)
- Wooden armor (cuz why not)
- A fast paced progression (the game is considered beaten when you craft the time machine which takes 1-2 hours)

 

Little tip : If you want to remove the annoying tutorial hints, modify the options.text or if you don't know what you're doing, just download a mod that remove them

(I personally use Disable ingame tutorial by Toma).
